title: The Empty Casket
logline: A merchant faking their own death hires a pilot to steal their empty casket before a suspicious notary opens it at the grand funeral.

roles.description: Very much alive, wearing a terrible disguise, extremely anxious.
Meticulous, humorless, suspects everyone of tax evasion.
A lavish orbital tomb filled with crying mourners.
The guild that monopolizes high-end burials.

public_situation: The {role:funeral_syndicate} is hosting a massive, highly publicized funeral for the {role:faking_merchant} at the {role:grand_mausoleum}.
private_truth: The merchant is faking their death to escape massive debts, and the sealed casket is actually completely empty.

beats.public_change: The notary pauses the funeral proceedings to demand a final visual confirmation of the body.

missions.reason: The notary hires the pilot to scan the casket for organic mass before they open it.
missions.private_fact: The wealthy merchant packed the ceremonial casket with gravel and ballast to stage an elaborate death and flee unpaid creditors.

beats.public_change: The notary orders the syndicate guards to force the casket open.

missions.reason: The merchant begs the pilot to meet a bribed undertaker at the mausoleum's loading dock and collect the casket before it can be opened.
missions.private_fact: The casket is incredibly heavy due to the sand.

beats.public_change: The notary locks down the mausoleum and issues an arrest warrant for the missing corpse.

missions.reason: The merchant asks the pilot to deliver the stolen casket to an incinerator to destroy the evidence.
missions.private_fact: The notary intercepts the pilot, demanding they hand over the casket so the fraud can be proven.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot has the empty casket. The notary is threatening them with accessory to fraud.

options.label: Incinerate the casket and let the merchant run
Give the casket to the notary

resolutions.summary: The casket burns. The notary has no proof, the merchant's debts are legally cleared, and they start a new life under a fake name.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot stole a casket from a funeral to help a merchant fake their own death.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the casket to the notary.
resolutions.summary: The notary opens the casket, exposing the bags of sand. The merchant is arrested for massive financial fraud.
The notary's guards seize the casket. The fraud is exposed, and the merchant is sent to a penal colony.

loose_threads.detail: The funeral syndicate knew the casket was empty and was charging the merchant a premium to look the other way.
The merchant casually mentions they owe money to the planetary governor, not just banks.

radio_hooks: Grand funeral for {role:faking_merchant} ends in chaos.

voice_direction.faking_merchant: Nervous, pitches up when lying, tries to sound casual.
